# WO-180: Guard developer broker-guide source citations
Status: open (ready; worktree pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3
Source: CP-31, issue #147; implementation authorized by the project owner on 2026-11-08

## Goal
Add a small offline regression test for file and line-range citations in `docs/dev/CONTRIBUTING_BROKERS.md`. The test protects the public schema and public sample references from drifting out of range; it does not judge whether the surrounding prose is semantically correct.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- First record the existing citation format and the exact target files/ranges used by the guide.
- Check only references to `schema/registry.schema.json` and `brokers/registry.sample.yaml`; each file must exist and each cited line or range must be within the current file's bounds.
- Keep the parser bounded to the guide's current citation syntax and fail clearly on malformed or out-of-range references.
- Tests use only local public files and make no network calls. No expected failures are needed; report a discovered content/reference defect to Nora rather than changing the guide or source data.
- Run `PYTHONPATH=src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_dev_broker_citations.py` and `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_dev_broker_citations.py` from the prepared worktree; record exact results in its `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_broker_citations.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
Do not read `brokers/SOURCES.md` or any private/research source list. Do not edit `docs/dev/CONTRIBUTING_BROKERS.md`, `schema/`, `brokers/`, application source, existing tests, or project configuration. No network, package installs, real personal data, or store access.

## Check-in plan
Start after `.vendor-wt/wo-180` is prepared on `vendor/wo-180`. Report progress and completion in the worktree status file and issue #147. Nora summarizes in `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.

## Notes and decisions
- This work order is based on CP-31 and is limited to the cited public schema/sample paths.
